# demo
---

<!-- Generated by docs/5-reference/generate.py from the doc comments: do not edit. -->

Package demo fills an empty database with a made-up studio, to try MUSA without typing a catalogue first: the works, fairs and orders of the author's design, a closed fair from last month, one happening today and three to come. It goes through the same stores as the screens.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| `func Fill(stores Stores) error` | Fill loads the demo data, but only into an empty database. |
| `type Code string` | Code is a stable name for what went wrong, for programs to check and people to search for. |
| `const CodeNotEmpty Code = "demo.not-empty" ...` | Error codes of this package. |
| `func CodeOf(err error) Code` | CodeOf is the code of an error the demo returned, or "" for any other error. |
| `type Error struct{ ... }` | Error is a failure of the demo: its code and what it was about. |
| `type Stores struct{ ... }` | Stores are the stores the demo writes through. |
